messages:
alex: FYI - auto-canary failed during staging promotion, deploy-bot paused it. Error from CI looks like tar extraction permission denied on a few bins.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/staging/image-unpack` failed. Log: https://ci.internal/redwood/1768612000
marina: Snippet from the runner log: ```
[2026-03-21T12:10:03Z] unpacking layer 5/8
tar: ./opt/redwood/bin/worker: Cannot change permissions to 04755: Permission denied
failed to unpack: operation not permitted
```
owen: We moved to `ubuntu:22.04-minimal` last sprint - feels like the rootless runners treat setuid/setgid bits specially. I can repro with podman rootless.
alex: We have a change window now. Proposal: pin Dockerfile base to last-good digest `sha256:abcdef1234` and re-run staging. Pin will be temporary while SRE investigates.
deploy-bot: Manual pin allowed. Promotion remains halted until a green pipeline and manual promote.
taylor: +1 to pin. Don't want to delay the release for image format nuances.
marina: I'll open a small PR to pin the base and include test to run an unpack sanity check in CI.
deploy-bot: PR #5468 opened: revert base -> sha256:abcdef1234. CI triggered.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #5468 completed: status=success.
alex: Requesting manual promote now.
alex: /promote release-2026-03-21 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion request queued. Required approvals: eng-releases (taylor), eng-sre (sam).
taylor: Approved.
sam: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressing: 0% -> 20% -> 50%. Healthchecks passing at 50%.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. No runtime errors observed in canary.
alex: Release unblocked, pinned base image temporarily. Creating follow-up ticket RW-3722 to track RCA and add rootless extraction tests to CI.
marina: Draft release note: "Temporarily pinned base image due to tar extraction permission failures on rootless CI runners; investigating setuid/setgid handling in minimal base images."
owen: I'll add the podman rootless repro and a proposed fix (strip setuid bits at build) to the ticket.
alex: Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Closing thread."
